angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 41,394,150 km at 4035.80 pc = 0.14 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AK Cep: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 4035.8 +/- 628 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 4035.8 +/- 628 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2314 +/- 0.0163 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12), 14.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 59.5 +/- 9.7 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AK Cep: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 59.5 +/- 9.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 41,394,150 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5375 +/- 168 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 359, Name='AK Cep', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 359, Name='AK Cep', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 2.12 from 2011AJ....142..136L; the 1 published value span log g 2.12 to 2.12, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....142..136L)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
